  THURSDAY, APRIL 11, 2024
  6201 APPIAN WAY
  LONG BEACH YACHT CLUB, 2:30 PM

Colin Kelly, Chair  Elizabeth Lambe, Commissioner
Jo Murray, Vice Chair  Bruce Mac Rae, Commissioner

  TAMALYN.SAYRE@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-52786  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Marine Advisory Commission
  meeting of Thursday, March 14, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-52787  Recommendation to approve the replacement of a memorial bench in Overlook
  Park to honor Casey Clark. (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-52806  Recommendation to approve the placement of a memorial bench to replace an
  existing standard bench in Colorado Lagoon to honor the Hayter family. (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-52897  Recommendation to conduct a study session regarding Trees in the Bay.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-52896  Recommendation to approve for submission to City Council the Marine Advisory
  Commission Annual Report for 2023.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-52788  Recommendation to receive and file the Manager's monthly oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  24-52789  Recommendation to receive and file the Committee status reports.

  6201 APPIAN WAY
  LONG BEACH YACHT CLUB, 2:30 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Marine Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Tamalyn Sayre, Bureau Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Marine Bureau office at (562) 570-3215 by noon,
the day prior to the meeting.
